Yes, fork digest is part of the topic strings in the form of `/eth2/ForkDigestValue/Name/Encoding`, so we need to unsubscribe the old ones and subsubscribe the new ones. thank you for confirming Yes QQ, do client teams expected to work with older forks? E.g will every client still support syncing from phase0 and doing fork transition altair/bellatrix etc. It sounds like archive node support via re-execution of every block, which is still relevant Some clients update cgc values only during finality. Is this the expected behaviour? cc: <@931591385545584640> <@680234424037670912> <@425907307621122049> <@520034910149410861> <@&595683849225240704> ``` DBG 2025-07-15 12:02:53.312+00:00 Peer status topics="peer_proto" peer=16U*xeMyuJ statusMsg="(forkDigest: b62f2b0e, finalizedRoot: \"d7839067\", finalizedEpoch: 4292, headRoot: \"c9e6819a\", headSlot: 137414)" ``` lighthouse erigon 2 supporting status v1 after fulu idk if that's expected behaviour ``` DBG 2025-07-15 12:23:40.527+00:00 Got incoming request from peer topics="peer_proto" peer=16U*z8MBBC msgName=statusV1Obj ``` grandine What is the expected behavior? StatusV1 deprecation immediately after the fork? Sorry, I didn’t follow up on that yeah I don’t think we have the depreciation mechanism, we only can prioritize the preferred version yeah in that case, just make sure to req /2 after fulu don't need to deprecate serving i guess, we haven't as well because our libp2p layer doesn't know what forks are Yeah we don't have any logic to deprecate support right after the fork. Its not required as the priority is higher for v2 Okay

excerpts.author: hangleang.eth
excerpts.content: a question to <@&1367819082019377202> devs: do you re-subscribe to gossip topics between BPO forks, given the fork digest changed?

excerpts.author: nc1234
excerpts.content: Yes, fork digest is part of the topic strings in the form of `/eth2/ForkDigestValue/Name/Encoding`, so we need to unsubscribe the old ones and subsubscribe the new ones.

excerpts.author: hangleang.eth
excerpts.content: thank you for confirming

excerpts.author: agnxsh
excerpts.content: Yes
